story_title: Miles Driven and Fuel Prices Over Decades
story_subtitle: Analyzing trends in vehicle usage and fuel costs from 1956 to 2010

story_pieces.narration: Total miles driven steadily increased over the decades, reaching a maximum of 10,067 miles.
